availability.note: VW AU model page lists 'MY26 Tayron eHybrid 150TSI Elegance' as one of two grades with MRDP footnotes for purchases 01/10/2026-31/12/2026; VW AU configurator shows a 'Tayron eHybrid' card with offer available. Dealer page (John Hughes VW) carries the same MY26 MRDP offer to 31/12/2026. No VW AU list price readable (MRDP amount not in page text; raw page fetch refused).

listPrice.note: CarExpert review (2 Jun 2026): $62,390 before on-road costs. Chasing Cars (20 Feb 2026, 'All prices listed are before on-road costs') and EV Central (27 Jun 2026, 'before on-road costs') give the same figure. No price change found to the research date; CarsGuide 2027 price page also lists 62,390 excluding stamp duty but its record gives the 200TSI eHybrid a 2.0L engine, so it is discarded per the one-error rule. VW AU MRDP drive-away amounts not readable.

batteryKwh.note: ADAC: Batteriekapazitaet (Brutto) 25,7 kWh, (Netto) 19,7 kWh for the same Tayron 1.5 eHybrid; usable figure used. EV Central also calls 19.7 kWh net.

rangeKm.note: Australian-spec claim 116 km (150TSI); VW AU model page gives 113-116 km. WLTP-derived (Chasing Cars labels 113-117 km WLTP): below the European WLTP best case of 119 km (150 kW, 18-inch, ADAC 345195) and in line with European 19-inch figures (115 km 150 kW / 114 km 200 kW). AU Elegance is on 19-inch, R-Line on 20-inch (EV Central).

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 19.7 / 116 x 100. CarExpert measured 18.0 kWh/100km on a 50 km E-Mode loop.

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm 116 + 45 L tank / 5.9 L/100km x 100 (762.7) = 879. Tank 45 L from CarExpert and ADAC.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer)' 5,9 L/100km for the 150 kW Tayron eHybrid on 255/45R19 (AU Elegance wheel size); the 18-inch 150 kW Elegance (345195) is 5,7. Same basis as kia-sorento-phev (ADAC battery-empty WLTP). Sibling check: Tiguan eHybrid 150 kW 18-inch, 1866 kg, is 5,7 (ADAC 345201), so the heavier Tayron reads higher. Held 7.0 was judged from UK real-world mpg.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: VW AU combined ADR 81/02 label 1.7 L/100km, at or below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car = combined CO2 120 g/km or less; CarExpert gives 37 g/km for this grade.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: VW AU '705L with rear seats in forward position', eHybrid with battery fitted (145 L less than petrol Tayron, CarExpert). VDA to the cargo cover per VW convention; ADAC lists the same 705 as 'normal'.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: ADAC 1915 L 'dachhoch, mit umgeklappter Ruecksitzbank' (to the roof); CarExpert and EV Central quote the same 1915 L. No belt-line folded figure found; kept to-roof, consistent with held data and kia-sorento-phev.

seats.note: VW AU: 5 seats; no third row on eHybrid (battery under rear floor, CarExpert).

towKg.note: CarExpert spec table braked 1800 kg; ADAC gives the same braked figure for the 150 kW car. VW AU technical spec sheet not reached.

warrantyYears.note: VW AU '5-year comprehensive warranty'; CarExpert: 5 years/unlimited km, battery 8 years/160,000 km. Unconditional.

insuranceAnnual.note: Held 1800 kept. Anchors: vw-tiguan-phev-150tsi-elegance $1750 at $64,590, skoda-kodiaq-phev-select $1900 at $63,490, mitsubishi-outlander-phev-aspire $1750 at $66,790, kia-sorento-phev-s-awd $1800 at $71,175.

depreciationCurve.note: VW brand convention: the single curve on every vw-id5 (and vw-tiguan-phev) row, per owner rule of one depreciation curve per brand. Held 2026-07-28 Tayron rows used steeper 0.70/0.36 and 0.68/0.34 curves with no documented evidence.
